rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for physically closing and reopening your eyes quickly.

example.english: I blink whenever I get nervous.
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 gan2 zoeng1 zau6 wui5 zaam2 ngaan5

rows.note: Use this for something such as a light or screen flashing on and off repeatedly.

example.english: The screen will blink on and off, so I can't see clearly.
example.traditional: 個螢幕閃吓閃吓，搞到我睇唔清楚。
example.jyutping: go3 jing4 mok6 sim2 haa5 sim2 haa5 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 tai2 m4 cing1 co2

rows.note: Use this mainly for stars or lights that twinkle or glimmer rather than for a regular warning flash.

example.english: The stars blink in the night sky and look beautiful.
example.jyutping: je6 hung1 ge3 sing1 sing1 sim2 soek3 hou2 leng3
